```ts title="Post"
import { Entity, EntityMixin } from '@data-client/rest';

export class Post extends Entity {
  id = 0;
  author = { id: 0 };
  title = '';
  body = '';
  votes = 0;

  static key = 'Post';

  static schema = {
    author: EntityMixin(
      class User {
        id = 0;
      },
    ),
  };
}
```

```ts title="PostResource" {15-22}
import { resource } from '@data-client/rest';
import { Post } from './Post';

export { Post };

export const PostResource = resource({
  path: '/posts/:id',
  searchParams: {} as { userId?: string | number } | undefined,
  schema: Post,
}).extend('vote', {
  path: '/posts/:id/vote',
  method: 'POST',
  body: undefined,
  schema: Post,
  getOptimisticResponse(snapshot, { id }) {
    const post = snapshot.get(Post, { id });
    if (!post) throw snapshot.abort;
    return {
      id,
      votes: post.votes + 1,
    };
  },
});
```

```html title="PostItem.vue" {10}
<script setup lang="ts">
  import { useController } from '@data-client/vue';
  import NumberFlow from '@number-flow/vue';
  import { PostResource, type Post } from './PostResource';

  const props = defineProps<{ post: Post }>();
  const ctrl = useController();

  const handleVote = () => {
    ctrl.fetch(PostResource.vote, { id: props.post.id });
  };
</script>

<template>
  <article class="listItem">
    <button class="upvote" @click="handleVote" aria-label="Upvote">
      <NumberFlow :value="post.votes" />
    </button>
    <div>
      <h4>{{ post.title }}</h4>
      <p class="meta">{{ post.body }}</p>
    </div>
  </article>
</template>
```

```html title="TotalVotes.vue" {13}
<script setup lang="ts">
  import { Query } from '@data-client/rest';
  import { useQuery } from '@data-client/vue';
  import NumberFlow from '@number-flow/vue';
  import { PostResource } from './PostResource';

  const queryTotalVotes = new Query(
    PostResource.getList.schema,
    posts => posts.reduce((total, post) => total + post.votes, 0),
  );

  const props = defineProps<{ userId: number }>();
  const totalVotes = useQuery(queryTotalVotes, () => ({ userId: props.userId }));
</script>

<template>
  <span v-if="totalVotes !== undefined" class="meta">
    <NumberFlow :value="totalVotes" /> votes
  </span>
</template>
```

```html title="PostList.vue"

  import { useSuspense } from '@data-client/vue';
  import { PostResource } from './PostResource';
  import PostItem from './PostItem.vue';
  import TotalVotes from './TotalVotes.vue';

  const userId = 2;
  const posts = await useSuspense(PostResource.getList, { userId });
</script>

<template>
  <header class="appHeader">
    <h1 class="appTitle">Posts</h1>
    <TotalVotes :userId="userId" />
  </header>
  <div class="list">
    <PostItem v-for="post in posts" :key="post.pk()" :post="post" />
  </div>
</template>
```
